name: time-input
title: Time input
description: Hour and minute segments you type into (4, 3, 0 gives 4:30) or step with the arrows, with an AM/PM toggle whose thumb slides, or a 24-hour mode. An optional list suggests times every 15 or 30 minutes, min and max explain the allowed window when a time falls outside it, and a relativeTo time adds an “In 2 hours” line. Paste “4:30 pm” to fill it at once.
